'''Black_wraith HeboB v2''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Black_wraith]]
* '''Published:''' 23 March 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif|label=Hidden Base}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|An Unusual Amount Of Fear|Ref3-L-anunusualamountoffear.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hidden Base
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 HB Black wraith LS 2004 5462.txt|Download]] (omits Rebel Planners (V), General Carlist Rieekan (V), Commander Luke Skywalker (V), Flash Of Insight (V), Dual Laser Cannon (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

HB + EBO = HeboB....this time with a Legitimate start

The published list has 69 cards.

== Notes ==

* Qty 69 as published: the nine '>' system lines under AUAOF (Hoth x2, Kiffex x2, Coruscant (se), Endor x2, Kessel x2) are not in any header count; the headers add to 60.
* Coruscant appears twice: '>Coruscant (se)' (Special Edition) and the base marker 'Coruscant (cor)' (Coruscant set); both are the card titled Coruscant.
* Battle Plan (Effects section) dested as the Endor Effect, not the Reflections III shield; EBO dested Echo Base Operations (Effect).
* Original-era (V): Commander Luke Skywalker (V), General Carlist Rieekan (V), Dual Laser Cannon (V) (Virtual Set 4); Flash Of Insight (V) (Virtual Set 5); Rebel Planners (V) (Virtual Set 6).
* Posted Rouge dested Rogue; Echo War room dested Hoth: Echo Command Center (War Room); Hoth MPG dested Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker); Bata Tank dested Bacta Tank.
* The Effects header says 11 but the list has 12 (Echo Base Garrison moved here from v1's starting list).

== Strategy ==

This is my second try at this “theoretical” deck, still no rendezvous point, but this time I’ve got a start that is legal.

Turn 1

Pull Rieekan, McQuarrie, and a DB. Deploy DB with Rieekan there, and use him to pull the shields (unless the shield was in your hand, other wise use him to either pull another site, a new secret base or a speeder). Play a system, play any X-Wings to rendezvous point.

Turn 2

Use Rieekan to pull, Hoth sentry, or a speeder (pull a site unless you’ve got them already) use Echo garrison to pull wedge, Luke or Bacta tack, and use a new secret base to pull any sites. Deploy McQuarrie and/or Luke/Hobbie with Speeder. Deploy system. Deploy any other cards possible (x-wings to rp, effects to table ect.). Draw any unused force

Turn 3

Use Rieekan to pull any other sites, Speeders, sentry, or ebo and echo base garrison to pull any applicable cards. Deploy system and any other cards.

Turn 4-5

Use Rieekan, ANSB and EBG to pull any thing useful. By this time you should have Rieekan at the war room, McQuarrie at the corridor, Hobbie at the DB and Luke at the 4th. Deploy ebo and systems until you get the flip, spread out x wings and drain like a sieve.

Reasons for Card Choices

>General McQuarrie—to make hoth sentry free, doubled, and for it to add all 3 modifiers.

>Hoth Sentry—to make it harder for ebo to get canceled.

>EBG—immunity and pullage

>Power pivot—Executor power ZERO

> Wedge RLS—Destiny cancelage

> a few maneuvers—trackable 6

>Slight weapons malfunction—to add a battle destiny in space or on hoth

>The signal—To pull effects

> Concentrate all fire—to add 3 to power of x-wings that fire their cannons

>Dual cannons—for walker protection

>Com. Luke—2 battle destines

>Bacta tank—To save luke or wedge if opponent gives you 6 or more attrition.

>x-wings—Fast and cheep

>Incom corp.—to give X-wings power +l and ability 2 piolits.

As I said above this is more of a theoretical deck, since I still don’t have a rendezvous point yet, so as for match ups, you tell me.
